discord.title: Discord Rich Presence
discord.description: Show your friends what you're playing, requires Discord to be running.

videoFirst.title: Music videos first
videoFirst.description: Open video songs in Watch. Audio tracks still use the music player.

keepWatching.title: Keep watching view
keepWatching.description: Keep the watching layout on track changes and return from automatic Picture-in-Picture. Manual Picture-in-Picture stays open.

flowImport.title: Flow playlist files (TIDAL import)
flowImport.description: Choose Flow playlist JSON files or ZIP archives. Playlists with existing names are skipped. Each playlist keeps its original track order.
flowImport.libraryFailed: Could not read the existing library. No playlists were saved. Try again.

reasons.invalidPlaylist: Failed: missing playlist name or videos array
reasons.emptyZip: Failed: ZIP contains no JSON files
reasons.saveFailed: Failed: library could not be saved

radio.geniusDescription: Endless playback with no automatic repeats. Enabling also turns autoplay on. Explicit replays and repeat modes remain available.
radio.exhausted: No unplayed tracks available. Choose another station or seed.

sensory.title: Dollhouse Deviants Sensory Suite

focus.title: Focus Mode
focus.description: Hide navigation and non-essential panels while watching or listening.

motion.title: Safe Motion
motion.description: Stop interface animations. New videos pause for photosensitivity consent. Footage itself is unchanged.

font.title: Readable Font (ADHD/Dyslexia)
font.description: Use a readable font stack, double line height, and wider letter and word spacing.

contrast.title: High Contrast
contrast.description: Strengthen text and control contrast in dark or light mode.

colorBlind.title: Color Blind Support
colorBlind.description: Underline links and reinforce selected states with symbols and labels.

light.title: Light Theme
light.description: Use a light background with dark text. Dark remains the default.

simplified.title: Simplified View
simplified.description: Hide images, thumbnails, posters, and decorative artwork. Video playback remains available.

sensory.advisory: Music videos may contain flashing lights or strobing imagery. Playback is paused. Continue only when you are comfortable watching.
sensory.motionAdvisory: Safe Motion reduces interface movement; it cannot remove flashes from video footage. Every new video waits for your consent.
sensory.shortcuts: Both players: K play/pause, J/L or arrows seek, ↑/↓ volume, N/P next/previous, F fullscreen, I mini-player/PiP. Tab and Enter operate controls. In the audio player, I toggles the dock; audio has no video PiP window.
